card.name: Half-life and accumulation in organ impairment
card.fires_on: The word completing a pharmacokinetic term, mainly "-life" after "elimination half", and also "accumulation", "elimination" or "concentration" in sentences about drug levels with kidney or liver impairment.

modes.label: Half-life
modes.description: The "-life" ending of "elimination half-life" in clearance and impairment passages.

modes.label: Accumulation or elimination
modes.description: Nouns about drug build-up or removal, often with renal impairment or dialysis.
